A [[Nexu/Legends|Nexu]] [[Claw/Legends|claw]] '''pendant''' was used by [[Rida Denru]] sometime before [[3626 BBY]]. Denru was the greatest [[Swooper/Legends|swooper]] in the history of the [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] [[Horizon's Razor]] and her colleagues saw the pendant as a good-luck charm to the gang.
